damast.packages.inherit: Inherit access from the linked repository
damast.packages.inherit_help: People and Actions workflows with read access to the linked repository can download this package; with write access they can publish new versions.
damast.file_tree.label: File tree
damast.file_tree.load_error: Could not load the file tree.
damast.drafts.create_help: Cannot be merged until marked ready for review. Code owners are asked for review then.
damast.drafts.still_draft: This pull request is still a draft.
damast.drafts.ready_help: Marking it ready for review removes the %s title prefix and asks code owners for review.
damast.packages.new_packages_owners: Only people who can publish packages for this owner (default)
damast.packages.new_packages_repo_writer: Also repository writers and Actions workflows, in container, npm, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems and generic registries
damast.packages.new_packages_help: A new package name is claimed for everyone, so by default only owners create one. Writers of a linked repository can always publish new versions of its packages. Other registries, such as Debian, RPM, PyPI or Cargo, keep new names for owners because GitHub has no such registry and some publish one signed index per owner.
damast.security.title: Security
damast.security.policy_none: This repository has no security policy yet.
damast.security.policy_hint: Add a SECURITY.md file to the root, .forgejo, .gitea, .github or docs folder to tell people how to report vulnerabilities.
damast.security.reporting_help: People who can read this repository can report vulnerabilities privately. Only repository admins, the reporter and invited collaborators see a report.
damast.security.reporting_on_hint: Found a vulnerability? Report it privately to the maintainers instead of opening an issue.
damast.security.report_submitted: Thank you. Your report was sent privately to the maintainers.
damast.security.private_notice: This advisory is private. Only repository admins, the reporter and collaborators on this advisory can see it.
damast.security.withdrawn_notice: This advisory was withdrawn %s. It no longer applies.
damast.security.publish_help: Publishing makes the advisory visible to everyone who can read this repository. The private discussion stays private.
damast.security.withdraw_help: Withdraw an advisory that turned out to be wrong. It stays visible, marked as withdrawn, and its OSV record gets a withdrawn date, so scanners stop reporting it. This cannot be undone.
damast.security.discussion_help: Comments stay private, also after the advisory is published.
damast.security.withdraw_confirm: Withdraw this advisory? This cannot be undone.
damast.security.collaborators_help: Collaborators see this advisory and its discussion before it is published.
damast.security.form.report_help: Only the repository admins see your report. They can accept it as a draft advisory, discuss it with you privately and publish it once a fix is out.
damast.security.field.title: Title
damast.security.field.cvss_help: Optional. When set, the severity follows the score.
damast.security.field.credits_help: User names separated by commas, optionally with a type such as finder or remediation_developer.
damast.security.field.affected_help: One package per row. Leave the last row empty, or fill it and save to get another one.
damast.security.error.title: A title is required and may have at most %d characters.
damast.security.error.description: A description is required and may have at most %d bytes.
damast.security.error.cvss: The CVSS vector is invalid. Use a complete CVSS 3.1 base vector such as CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H.
damast.security.error.state_unknown: Unknown state "%s". Use triage, draft, published, closed or withdrawn.
damast.security.error.severity: The severity must be low, moderate, high or critical.
damast.security.error.severity_cvss: The severity follows the CVSS score (%s). Change the CVSS vector, or remove it to set the severity yourself.
damast.security.error.cve: The CVE ID must look like CVE-2026-12345.
damast.security.error.cwe: "%s" is not a CWE ID. Use the form CWE-79.
damast.security.error.too_many: At most %d affected products, CWEs and credits each.
damast.security.error.range: The vulnerable versions of %s are invalid. Use "= 1.2", "< 2.0", "<= 2.0", ">= 1.0" or ">= 1.0, < 2.0".
damast.security.error.patched: The patched version of %s must be a single version such as 1.4.2.
damast.security.error.credit_private: %s does not have a public profile and cannot be credited.
damast.security.error.state: An advisory in state %s cannot become %s.
damast.security.error.comment: A comment must not be empty and may have at most %d bytes.
damast.security.error.collaborator: Only active users can be collaborators.
damast.security.error.collaborator_acces: %s cannot read the code of this repository. Give them read access first.
damast.security.error.too_many_reports: You have too many open vulnerability reports. Wait until the maintainers have handled them.
damast.security.mail.accepted: %s accepted the report. It is now a draft advisory.
damast.security.mail.reopened: %s reopened the advisory as a draft.
damast.security.mail.added_collaborator: %s added you as a collaborator on a private security advisory.
damast.security.mail.footer: You get this e-mail because you can see this private security advisory of %s. Do not forward it.
